description: A harmonized inventory of ground-mounted photovoltaic installations in India, 2019–2022 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors J Santhakumar, T Mariprasath (SRM Institute of Science and Technology). # Global PV Inventory, India (2019-2022 backbone, 2022 snapshot) ## Summary This dataset is a deduplicated, attribute-enriched vector inventory of 3,616 ground-mounted, utility-scale photovoltaic (PV) installations in India, produced by fusing three openly-licensed source datasets, the WRI Global Power Plant Database (`wri_gppd`), Kruitwagen et al. Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
